title: Sources detail how xAI has been slowed down by internal chaos as Musk pushed for Grok to match Claude, amid signs it is turning a corner under Michael Nicolls (Carmen Arroyo/Bloomberg)
summary: Carmen Arroyo / Bloomberg: Sources detail how xAI has been slowed down by internal chaos as Musk pushed for Grok to match Claude, amid signs it is turning a corner under Michael Nicolls — The company wants to compete with Anthropic's Claude but has been slowed down by internal chaos and an inconsistent strategy.
